title: B-Roll: Coast Guard, partners rescue 8 from missing fishing vessel in the Pacific north of Palau
description: Petty Officer 2nd Class Brandon Myers and Petty Officer 3rd Class Conner Henderson, drop-masters aboard an Air Station Barbers Point HC-130 Hercules, deliver life-saving supplies to the Indonesian-flagged fishing vessel KM Aleluya north of Palau, Aug. 14, 2019. The crew of the Hallelujar was adrift for ten days without electricity, food, and water, and was rescued through joint efforts by the U.S. Coast Guard, U.S. Air Force and good Samaritans aboard the AMVER vessel Isl Star. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Mitchell Recker and Petty Officer 3rd Class Conner Henderson/Released)
keywords: HC-130 Hercules, Palau, Air Station Barbers Point, District 14, Sector Guam, dropmaster, Coast Guard, SAR
